content.text: Found it. The line `(c >= 0xFE70 && c <= 0xFEFF)` was introduced in commit `9431bdc995af7ff28a6a227dcf9e07f3f0135069`. Let me verify this commit's full context.

This confirms it: commit `9431bdc995af7ff28a6a227dcf9e07f3f0135069` originally introduced the entire `isRTLCharacter` method, including the line `(c >= 0xFE70 && c <= 0xFEFF)`, which the fix commit later corrected to `0xFEFE`. This is the same commit immediately preceding the fix in the log (`9431bdc99` in the recent commits list), authored by the same person, as part of introducing new Bidi/RTL text processing functionality.

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 9431bdc995af7ff28a6a227dcf9e07f3f0135069

## Reasoning
(1) I used `git log --follow -p` on `core/java/android/text/TextUtils.java` to trace every historical change to the `0xFE70`/`0xFEFF` range boundary in the `isRTLCharacter` method. I searched the full diff output for occurrences of "FE70" to find where this specific range check was added or modified.

(2) The search showed only two commits touch that exact line: the bug-fix commit itself (`8e0deafda`, which changes `0xFEFF` → `0xFEFE`), and commit `9431bdc995af7ff28a6a227dcf9e07f3f0135069`, which is where the line `(c >= 0xFE70 && c <= 0xFEFF)    ;` was first added as part of introducing the brand-new `isRTLCharacter` method (along with `hasRTLCharacters` and `processBidi` bidi/reshaping support). No commit between these two touched this line, confirming this is a direct, uninterrupted introduction-to-fix chain.

(3) Evidence: `9431bdc995` is authored by the same person (Eran Mizrahi) as the fix commit, is the immediate parent-generation commit in the repository's history for this file, and its diff shows the entire `isRTLCharacter` function being added fresh with the (arguably off-by-one, since `0xFEFF` is a non-character/BOM code point that shouldn't be classified as RTL-shapeable Arabic presentation forms) upper bound of `0xFEFF` instead of the correct `0xFEFE`. This is a single-commit, high-confidence identification — the line was untouched by any other commit between introduction and fix.
